description.en: Called by the engine by name (the string "InitEvent" is passed to the script call routine in the binary, with one argument). The ev_main version only prints the debug line "InitEvent" with SPrint. An event script can define its own InitEvent to replace it.
Argument passed by the engine (not used by the ev_main version).
